items.reason: The Lift field grants row movement and marking through WorkBuildOptions.
Only the shipped active preset sets Lift to true.
The pin alias sets Lift without adding a warning or finding.
The decoder reads lift after pin, so lift takes precedence.
An undeclared Lift field defaults to false.
Both spellings record non-bool values as findings without failing the load.
Derived-ordering identifiers, comments, and test filenames use lift; alias references remain explicit.
The diff leaves the listed manual and unrelated pin meanings unchanged.
The field description and shipped grant use lift; pin is a read alias.
The sibling-worktree test checks that the trunk-bound Task set lifts.
Checkout attribution returns before repository attribution and keeps its existing ranking.
Tag attribution remains first and has a repository regression test.
Repository candidates include Task sets with and without bindings.
Cursor keys still use project name and container ID; matching IDs in repositories with the same project name can lift the wrong row.
Missing repository identity and unknown repositories produce no lift or message.
The repository pass merges all answers, with a test where two kinds answer.
Launch stores repository identity; a counting git test checks five rebuilds add no identity calls.
Status uses empty pane facts and bypasses attribution and its git resolution.
Lifting operates on admitted rows and does not change preset filtering.
Repository attribution indexes every Map without a live-state check; archived Maps can lift when a preset admits them.
Repository answers place Task sets before Maps, checked with both real kinds.
Map session attribution returns before repository attribution, with a regression test.
Routines implement no locality pass, and a comment explains the deliberate difference.

scores.rationale: Clear structure and broad tests, but repository key collisions and non-live Map lifting remain; Map attribution also ignores ascending preset order.
